name: io.github.alicexixi85/us-market-regime-mcp
title: U.S. Market Regime
description: End-of-day QQQ/VIX GREEN/YELLOW/RED market regime context. Educational, not investment advice.

tools.name: get_us_market_regime
tools.description: Fetch the live end-of-day U.S. market regime (GREEN/YELLOW/RED), risk score (0-100), QQQ vs 200d SMA & drawdown, VIX vs 20d average, SMH semiconductor relative strength, 25-day distribution count, and non-advisory educational risk-sizing context.

include_methodology.description: Include indicator methodology details in the response (default false).

tools.name: calculate_prop_firm_drawdown
tools.description: Calculate deterministic prop-firm drawdown survival math: remaining trailing buffer, max consecutive losses before daily or trailing breach, and recommended buffer-anchored 1R dollar and contract caps.

account_size.description: Nominal evaluation or funded account balance in USD (default 50000).

max_trailing_drawdown.description: Maximum trailing or static drawdown allowance in USD (default 2000).

daily_loss_limit.description: Maximum single-day loss limit in USD (default 1000).

risk_per_trade_usd.description: Planned dollar risk per trade (1R). Overrides planned_stop_points if provided.

planned_stop_points.description: Optional stop distance in index points (e.g., 10 points on NQ/MNQ).

point_value_usd.description: Dollar value per point per contract (default 20 for NQ; use 2 for MNQ, 50 for ES, 5 for MES).

tools.name: start_blind_chart_drill
tools.description: Return an instant zero-login masked-ticker historical U.S. stock bar-by-bar practice session URL, structured execution protocol, and $0 Pre-Market Checklist link.

focus.description: Execution skill to focus on during the blind historical drill.
